# Bible Copilot

> Bible Copilot is an AI Bible study app for iPhone and iPad. Ask any question about any Bible verse and get a clear, Scripture-cited answer in seconds — with six purpose-built study modes, verse-anchored answers, guided reading plans, and a study journal. Free to download; Pro unlocks unlimited questions with a 7-day free trial.

Bible Copilot is built for inductive Bible study: it lets Scripture interpret Scripture, cites verses for every answer, and stays denominationally humble (it presents mainstream Christian interpretations rather than picking sides). It is a native iOS app, not a ChatGPT wrapper: every study mode uses purpose-built prompts designed for Bible study, and answers are anchored to the biblical text.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone & iPad), App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bible-copilot-ai-bible-study/id6758913373
- Study modes: Summary, Observe, Interpret, Theology, Apply, Apologetics (inductive method: observe → interpret → apply)
- Free tier: 3 questions/day, no account required, no ads
- Pro: unlimited questions, all reading plans, journal — 7-day free trial, cancel anytime
- Made by an independent Christian developer; no data selling, no ads
